panels.title: Activity slots used
panels.description: Activity slots currently occupied. Capped by WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIVITIES.

panels.title: Activity slot utilisation
panels.description: At 100% the Worker is the bottleneck and tasks queue on the server instead.

panels.title: Activity pollers
panels.description: Long-poll goroutines waiting on the Activity task queue.

panels.title: Workflow task pollers
panels.description: Long-poll goroutines waiting on Workflow tasks, sticky and normal.

panels.title: Activity tasks/sec
panels.description: Activity tasks handed to this Worker, including retries.

panels.title: Worker restarts
panels.description: Worker instances started since this process began. Counters reset with the process, so this is 1 unless the SDK restarted a Worker in place.

panels.title: Task slots: used vs available
panels.description: Available hitting zero is slot starvation: work is ready but the Worker cannot accept it.

panels.title: Slot utilisation by worker type
panels.description: Used over total capacity per pool.

targets.expr: sum by (worker_type) (temporal_worker_task_slots_used{component="worker"}) / clamp_min(sum by (worker_type) (temporal_worker_task_slots_used{component="worker"}) + sum by (worker_type) (temporal_worker_task_slots_available{component="worker"}), 1)

panels.title: Pollers by type
panels.description: Poller counts move with slot availability: the SDK stops polling when it has nowhere to put the work.

panels.title: Activity tasks received/sec
panels.description: eager=true means the task was delivered on the Workflow task response instead of a poll.

panels.title: Activity schedule-to-start latency
panels.description: Time an Activity task sat on the queue before this Worker picked it up. Growth here means not enough slots or not enough pollers.

panels.title: Activity execution latency
panels.description: Duration of a single attempt, successful or not. For this demo, roughly (items remaining) x JOB_PER_ITEM_MILLIS.

panels.title: Activity end-to-end latency (successful)
panels.description: Schedule to success across every retry. The gap against execution latency is retry cost.

panels.title: Activity execution failures/sec
panels.description: Failed attempts as the SDK counts them.

panels.title: Activity throughput: started vs failed
panels.description: Started should equal succeeded plus failed once the window settles.

panels.title: Workflow task polls: succeed vs empty
panels.description: Mostly-empty polls are normal at low load; they are long-poll timeouts, not errors.

panels.title: Workflow task schedule-to-start latency
panels.description: Queue wait for Workflow tasks. Sticky routing should keep this near zero.

panels.title: Workflow task execution latency
panels.description: How long the Workflow code ran for one task. Long here blocks the whole Workflow cache slot.

panels.title: Workflow task replay latency
panels.description: Cost of rebuilding Workflow state from history after a sticky cache miss.

panels.title: Workflow task failures/sec
panels.description: Non-zero means Workflow code threw. Distinct from Activity failures, which are expected here. Reads zero until the metric first appears.

panels.title: Workflows completed/sec
panels.description: Workflow completions as observed by this Worker.

panels.title: Workflow end-to-end latency
panels.description: Workflow start to close. Bounded below by items x per-item millis, inflated by every Activity retry.

panels.title: Sticky cache
panels.description: Cache misses force a replay, which is why replay latency and this panel move together.

panels.title: Requests vs failures
panels.description: Short RPCs only. Long polls are counted separately below.

panels.title: Requests/sec by operation
panels.description: RecordActivityTaskHeartbeat dominates by design: the Activity heartbeats once per item.

panels.title: Request latency p95 by operation
panels.description: Server round-trip per RPC type as the SDK measures it.

panels.title: Request failures/sec by operation
panels.description: Heartbeat failures matter most here, because a dropped heartbeat is a lost checkpoint. The total series holds the panel at zero until the failure metric first appears.

panels.title: Long-poll requests/sec by operation
panels.description: PollActivityTaskQueue and PollWorkflowTaskQueue. Rate reflects poll turnover, not load.

panels.title: Long-poll latency p95 by operation
panels.description: Sits at the server long-poll timeout when the queue is idle; drops under load.
